title: Android XML RadioButton: button drawable selector
purpose: Check a custom Android XML button drawable selector on RadioButton while preserving single selection and RTL behavior.
changes: Added solid-shape button drawables and supported state selectors to RadioButton. The example uses a blue circle when selected, amber square when unselected and gray circle when disabled.
steps: Scroll to Android XML button drawable selector. Standard starts selected with a blue circle; Express has an amber square; Unavailable has a gray circle.
Tap Express. Its indicator should become a blue circle, and Standard should become an amber square. Tap Standard to switch back; only one option should be selected.
Tap Unavailable and check that its gray circle and the current selection remain unchanged.

Turn on Right-to-left layout near the top. The indicators should move to the right and the enabled options should still select one at a time. Choose OK if the steps work, or Reject with the failing step, what you saw and your device.
expected: The drawable selector supplies the visible state shape, enabled choices remain mutually exclusive, the disabled choice cannot select, and indicators follow layout direction.
limits: Only solid rectangular or circular XML shapes up to 32 dp, supported state selectors and @null are covered. Bitmap, vector and animated drawables, tint compositing and exact Android device appearance remain open.

references.scope: Compound button drawable and checked state.

validation: 144 Android XML importer tests passed, including RadioButton shape selector import.
Three Rust RadioGroup tests passed, including custom checked, unchecked and disabled drawable states, single selection and RTL.
